Class AmwpFacade

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpFacade
@Component public class AmwpFacade extends Object
The AmwpFacade class is the server AMWP Scope A handler. Bantha Roux is RAM only. Cell turns go to that RAM region. Cells never enter the VT100 Roux. The execute semaphore holds 3 permits. Lane.LLM_EXEC stays a pool of 4 threads.
invalid reference 
ChatShell
does not take this semaphore. A caller sends frames through handle(String, AmwpFrame, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink). A caller sends one console turn through completeTurn(String, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody, List). A tool frame is refused. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#AmwpFacade // @aa-sdd G-08 G-09 G-10 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • AmwpFacade

      public AmwpFacade(RouxChatMemory rouxMemory, LlmRouter llmRouter, Lamina lamina, CasseroleProperties properties, GrokLlmService grokLlm, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.num-ctx:0}") int numCtx, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.base-url:http://localhost:11434}") String ollamaBaseUrl, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.model:}") String ollamaModel)
      The constructor stores the collaborators and builds the maps. The execute semaphore starts with 3 permits. A null Ollama model is stored as empty. A model value is trimmed. The base URL loses one trailing slash through trimSlash(String). The pool chat is a new PoolChatServer for these properties.
      Parameters:
      rouxMemory - The memory is the Roux chat memory.
      llmRouter - The router is the provider map.
      lamina - The lamina is the lane pool.
      properties - The properties are the server settings.
      grokLlm - The service lists Grok language models. A null service answers the catalog with the header only.
      numCtx - The number is spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.num-ctx. 0 omits num_ctx.
      ollamaBaseUrl - The URL is spring.ai.ollama.base-url. Empty uses http://localhost:11434.
      ollamaModel - The model is spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.model. Empty stays empty.

    • handle

      public void handle(String user, AmwpFrame frame, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink replyTo)
      The handle method accepts one Scope A, stream, or tool frame. A null frame returns without a reply. A null sink returns without a reply. A keepalive returns without a reply. A tool frame replies failed and no tool is invocable, then returns. A cancel drops the live token, cancels the cell HTTP call, and cancels the in-flight task. A type other than data returns without a reply. A channel A body that starts with show: is answered off the execute path. A channel A body that starts with tags: is answered off the execute path. A channel A body that starts with grok_models: is answered off the execute path. A cell that is already running replies cell-busy. Any other data frame takes a new token and waits for an execute permit. The waiter thread is named aetheris-execute-wait and is a daemon. The task lane is Lane.LLM_EXEC and the task name is aetheris-execute. The task releases the permit in finally.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user.
      frame - The frame is the inbound frame.
      replyTo - The sink is the mux writer.

    • toolAllowed

      private boolean toolAllowed(String toolName)
      The toolAllowed method reports whether a tool may run. The depth is 1. The allowlist is empty. No name passes. A depth below 1 returns false. A null name returns false. An empty name returns false. Every other name returns false.
      Parameters:
      toolName - The tool name is the tool.
      Returns:
      The return value is false.

    • showId

      private static String showId(byte[] body)
      The showId method reads a model id from a show: line. A null body returns null. An empty body returns null. The first line is the text before the first newline. A first line that does not start with show: returns null. cell_id: is not a show. The returned id is the trimmed text after show:. That id may be empty.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the stripped payload.
      Returns:
      The return value is the model id, or null when this frame is not a show.

    • answerShow

      private void answerShow(AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink replyTo, byte[] cellId, String modelId)
      The answerShow method posts /api/show off the execute path. The worker thread is named aetheris-show and is a daemon. The reply is channel A type data. The text is showResult(String). A send failure is ignored. The base URL is not written on the reply.
      Parameters:
      replyTo - The sink is the mux writer.
      cellId - The cell id is the cell that asked.
      modelId - The model id is the text after show:.

    • showResult

      private String showResult(String modelId)
      The showResult method builds a show_result: body. A null id is empty. An empty id uses the configured Ollama model. The first line is show_result: plus the id. A blank id returns that line and does not call Ollama. The call is a POST to the base URL plus /api/show. The timeout is 10 seconds. The JSON body is model set to the id. A status outside 200 through 299 returns the header only. Value lines are the textual levels from thinking.values. An empty level is skipped. A level that contains a newline or a carriage return is skipped. true is skipped. false is skipped. Each kept level is value: plus the level. An exception returns the header only. The base URL is not written on the reply.
      Parameters:
      modelId - The model id is the requested id.
      Returns:
      The return value is the show_result: body.

    • answerTags

      private void answerTags(AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink replyTo, byte[] cellId)
      The answerTags method gets /api/tags off the execute path. The worker thread is named aetheris-tags and is a daemon. The reply is channel A type data. The text is tagsResult(). A send failure is ignored. A miss carries no model lines. The base URL is not written on the reply.
      Parameters:
      replyTo - The sink is the mux writer.
      cellId - The cell id is the cell that asked.

    • tagsResult

      private String tagsResult()
      The tagsResult method builds a tags_result: body. The call is a GET of the base URL plus /api/tags. The timeout is 10 seconds. A status outside 200 through 299 returns the header only. A body whose models field is not an array returns the header only. Each textual name without a newline or a carriage return becomes model: plus that name. An empty name is skipped. An exception returns the header only.
      Returns:
      The return value is the tags_result: body.

    • execute

      private void execute(String user, String cellKey, long token, byte[] cellId, byte[] body, AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink replyTo)
      The execute method runs one cell turn. A token that is no longer live returns without a reply. doorBanner(String, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody) stops the turn when it returns text. That text is sent only when the token is still live. assembleMessages(AmwpToon.ExecuteBody) builds the prompt. An unknown role replies with the exception message, or unknown role when the message is null. holdRoux(String, String, long, List) false returns without a provider call. routedComplete(String, String, long, byte[], AmwpFacade.AmwpReplySink, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody, List, boolean) runs the provider. AmwpFacade.QuietStop and GrokLlmService.CallStopped return without another frame. A null reply is sent as empty. A reply that does not fit replies too-large. A fitting reply is channel stream type data, then type EOF with an empty body. The EOF is skipped when the token is no longer live. Any other exception replies failed with garnered(Exception) when the token is still live.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user.
      cellKey - The cell key is the live-token key.
      token - The token is this execute.
      cellId - The cell id is the wire id.
      body - The body is the stripped payload.
      replyTo - The sink is the mux writer.

    • completeTurn

      public String completeTurn(String user, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody req, List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages) throws Exception
      The completeTurn method runs one console turn. The method does not take an execute permit. The method does not send an AMWP frame. doorBanner(String, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody) throws Exception when it returns text. A null message list is built by assembleMessages(AmwpToon.ExecuteBody).
